title_sq: SHITET DUPLEX TEK REZIDENCA "TIRANA GOLDEN PARK 3"!! 140,000 €

Shitet i mobiluar si ne foto.
title_en: DUPLEX FOR SALE AT "TIRANA GOLDEN PARK 3" RESIDENCE!! €140,000
